title: Packing
intro: 14 days, China then Vietnam, September (Beijing 20–28°C; Vietnam 28–32°C humid). Plan return luggage expansion for Vietnam shopping; light outbound, packable duffel for haul.

tables.caption: Document Folder Sections
rows: Visa; hotel; Great Wall + Forbidden City confirmations
E-visa (2 copies); Hanoi hotel; resort; domestic flight; tailor appointment
Insurance; card list; emergency contacts card

tables.caption: Luggage Setup
rows: Under seat or overhead per airline
Fist-size packed; second checked bag for purchases

bullets.heading: Core Do Not Forget (15)
items: Passports valid through March 2027; China visa; Vietnam e-visa (2 printed each)
VPN on both phones BEFORE China entry; Airalo eSIMs downloaded
Schwab debit + backup credit card; banks notified
Prescriptions 14+3 days; universal adapter (A/C plugs both countries)
20,000 mAh power bank; DEET 30%; SPF 50 (2 bottles); packing cubes
Packable daypack; CBP Form 4457; hotel/flight confirmations (cloud + print)

bullets.heading: China Gear (Beijing)
items: Walking shoes with grip (Great Wall); light layer for AC/temples
Real camera for Wall, Forbidden City, Jingshan sunset

bullets.heading: Vietnam Gear
items: Rain poncho (typhoon season); long sleeve for evening mosquitoes
Modest temple wear or buy linen shirt in Hội An; GoPro for Cham Islands

bullets.heading: Health Kit Placement
items: Prescriptions + OTC (Imodium, antihistamine, ibuprofen) in carry-on
DEET + first aid in checked; 1 sunscreen carry-on (<100ml) or buy second in Vietnam

bullets.heading: Shopping Return Strategy
items: Foldable duffel becomes second checked bag; tailor compression for suits
Non Nước marble ships internationally—don't carry
CBP 4457 valuables in carry-on; if zipper strains, ship via DHL Vietnam (7–10 days US)

callouts.text: Install VPN and eSIMs before China entry—not after arrival
TSA: consolidate carry-on liquids in one quart bag; buy extra sunscreen in Vietnam if needed
One universal adapter covers China and Vietnam plug types A and C
